name: Acceptance test 15 - public role trust (role-trust, supported)
note: IAM-801: role-trust is supported. Principal:* + sts:AssumeRole with no Resource is unrestricted (public) role trust -> critical TRUST-PUBLIC. It is NOT evaluated as an identity policy, so the omitted Resource never produces a spurious broad-Resource finding. The role's permissions remain unknown/out of scope on the finding.
